items.name: Meta Pike County, Ohio power agreement
items.claim: Oklo announced an agreement with Meta Platforms that advances Oklo's plans to develop a 1.2 GW power campus in Pike County, Ohio, to support Meta's data centers in the region.
items.source_excerpt: announced an agreement with Meta Platforms, Inc. (Nasdaq: META) that advances Oklo’s plans to develop a 1.2 GW power campus in Pike County, Ohio, to support Meta’s data centers in the region.

items.name: Pike County power campus construction timeline
items.claim: Pre-construction and site characterization for Oklo's Pike County campus are slated to begin in 2026, with the first phase targeted to come online as early as 2030.
items.source_excerpt: Pre-construction and site characterization are slated to begin in 2026, with the first phase targeted to come online as early as 2030.

notes: Both items sourced from the stored 1 Sep 2026 Oklo/Meta press release (data/web/38e2dc3326277a1b.json). No dollar figure is disclosed for the prepayment/funding mechanism.
